Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

csvschema 0.0.0.9000

Initial implementation, built bottom-up from the design brief.

  • Codec (encode.R): percent-encoding to a pure-ASCII, separator-safe token form (cs_encode_token()/cs_decode_token()) and cs_crc32().
  • Schema model (schema.R): cs_schema() from data frames (factors, ordered factors, haven::labelled, Date, POSIXct, integer/double, logical, character), one-to-one mapping to Frictionless Table Schema v2, lossless conversion both ways, and cs_to_coltypes() / cs_to_readr_spec().
  • Wire format (packetize.R, parse.R): cs_packetize() with deterministic first-fit fragmentation, cs_parse_packets(), and cs_recover() with the four statuses (verified, conflict, incomplete, absent), a per-packet CRC-32 and a whole-schema SHA-1.
  • Layout (layout.R): the redundancy math (cs_copies(), cs_redundancy(), cs_survival()) and a reproducible rotating stripe (cs_stripe(), cs_lay()).
  • Canary (canary.R): a purposeful value sampler, canary packets, and a two-level check (cs_canary_check()) that names the kind of data damage.
  • I/O (io_write.R, io_read.R): cs_write() and cs_read_csv(), column detection by content, schema application, and a Frictionless datapackage.json sidecar with cross-hashes.
  • Simulators (corrupt.R): the cs_corrupt_*() family, one per threat-model vector.
  • Reporting (report.R): the cs_report object, one-line summaries and tables.

Design notes and known limits

  • The package name is csvschema and the API prefix is cs_ (the brief used the working name schemaless / sl_).
  • The rotating stripe guarantees recovery from a head()/prefix, from any window of at least 2P - 1 consecutive rows, from full-file reads, and from the systematic every-P-th-row sample. A single period-P stripe cannot also guarantee every arbitrary strided sample in its first P terms; heavy arbitrary strides rely on the redundancy r, not the stripe.
  • Case folding of every cell is detected, not recovered: the per-packet CRC covers the exact-case payload, so folded payloads fail their CRC and are dropped. Recovery reports the loss rather than returning a silently wrong schema.
  • With the default missingValues = [""], an empty cell reads back as NA; "" and NA are indistinguishable once written with na = "".
  • Two vectors cannot be mitigated in-band: deletion of every schema column, and bit-level damage to a compressed container.
